u0: Initial/reset state: the agent does not have valid key-secured progress and is not currently holding the matching door key. Its immediate objective is to find and pick up the door-colored key to enter the key-acquired phase; this is also the recovery objective after dropping or losing the key while the ball was away from the door. Do not pick up the target box in this state: that gives a negative outcome and does not reach the high-reward terminal. The ball is already away from the door at reset, so no ball move is needed for access, but key possession must be re-established.
u1: Key-secured phase: the matching door key has been acquired. While the ball is away from the door (blocker_moved true), the agent must keep the matching key in hand; dropping or otherwise losing it then resets to u0 with a penalty. If the ball is back on the cell in front of the door (blocker_moved false), the key may be put down to free the hands. The next objective is to open the door if needed and reach the target box; for the high-reward completion, the target box must be picked up while blocker_moved is false, meaning the ball is in front of the door. u1 is an accepting/final state if the episode ends here, but u2 is the high-reward final outcome.
u2: High-reward terminal state: the mission target box has been picked up while the ball was not away from the door (blocker_moved false), so the key-secured condition was not violated at completion. The task is complete and this state is absorbing; no further objective remains.
